description.value:
A mutated hound-thing, too many teeth for the mouth it's wearing. Fast, aggressive, built to close distance and not let go.

SIGNATURE — its bite can drag a Marked target off its feet; by Alpha stage, a hit from either of you sets up the other's next attack.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'; target:mark:quarry is live for the "drag a Marked target off its feet" half, on the Feral Bond's own bite). What stays blocked is independent: (1) "by Alpha stage, a hit from either of you sets up the other's next attack" buffs/grants actions across two different actors' items -- no rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet (confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem, Ranger/Druid, where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too); (2) Feral Bond growth stages (Whelp/Bonded/Alpha/Apex-Touched, classes.waywarden.json terms) have no tracked data field anywhere in the corpus, so a stage requirement like "at least Alpha stage" has no roll option or actor property to predicate against.
